message.content: Help me replace the current text in an editor with 'Hello, World!' starting from position 5 and covering the next 7 characters?

function.name: setText
function.description: This function sets new text in an editor, starting from a specified position for a given length. If the length is not specified, it replaces text till the end. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

newText.description: The new text to set. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.

start.description: The starting position for the new text. This is JavaScript float type parameter in string representation.

length.description: The length of text to replace. Optional parameter. Default 0.0 This is JavaScript float type parameter in string representation.
